name: Molly House

categories.label: Joy at game end (before final scoring)
categories.labelVi: Joy khi kết thúc (trước tính điểm cuối)
categories.hint: Player joy marker on the joy track. Community Survival / hanged players: joy only counts if not hanged.

categories.label: Loyal tokens at open houses
categories.labelVi: Token trung thành ở nhà chưa bị đột kích
categories.hint: Community Survival only: 2 joy per own loyal token on an open molly house.

categories.label: Joy lost at trial (indictments)
categories.labelVi: Joy mất khi bị xét xử
categories.hint: Community Survival only: total joy lowered by rolled indictment cards. Joy cannot fall below 0.

categories.label: Hanged (noose)
categories.hint: Flip joy marker if a trial shows a noose, or in Community Infiltration if not a successful informer. Hanged players cannot win.

categories.label: Successful informer (token on a raided house)
categories.labelVi: Chỉ điểm thành công (token ở nhà bị đột kích)
categories.hint: Informer token placed on a molly house that has been raided by game end.

categories.label: Informer victory points (Community Infiltration only)
categories.labelVi: Điểm VP của người chỉ điểm (chỉ khi kết thúc Infiltration)
categories.hint: houseEvidence = evidence at your informer house; othersRep = other players' reputation matching that house; ownRep = your own reputation in all suits.

categories.label: Player wins
categories.hint: Survival: highest joy, not hanged (ties share). Infiltration: highest positive informer VP (ties or none >0: all lose). Atrophy: all lose.

tiebreakers.description: Community Survival: tied players with the highest joy who are not hanged share the victory.
Community Infiltration: if any players tie for highest VP, or no player scores above zero, all players lose.

winCondition: Three endings checked at End of the Week. Community Infiltration (all 4 houses raided or a raided house has 7+ evidence): everyone is hanged except successful informers; the informer with the highest positive VP wins (tie or none above zero = all lose). Community Survival (checked after Infiltration: community joy marker reached the threshold for the player count): pardon successful informers, failed informers get a major indictment, loyal tokens at open houses score 2 joy each, then trials; the highest-joy player who is not hanged wins (ties share). Community Atrophy (week 5 ends with neither): all players lose.

endCondition.description: Up to five weeks; game may end at End of the Week by Infiltration, Survival or Atrophy.

roles.label: Molly (loyal or informer)
roles.winCondition: Survival: most joy and not hanged. Infiltration: only successful informers can win, with the highest VP.

notes: family: hidden-informer-competitive. Verified against the official rulebook (pp.7, 14, 15 Game End and Victory). Trial rolls (d10) depend on indictment cards: scorer enters total joy lost. Joy marker is 0 for informers in Infiltration. Solo rules are a separate rulebook and not modelled. 2-5 player range assumed from BGG (1-5 incl. solo); rulebook defines threshold per player count on the joy track.
